about: check_patch_observation.py: every difference of openfhe-v1.6.1-tracer.patch that is not an observation hook, with the reason it changes no computed value. 'residue': hunks whose two sides differ after deleting the hook macros (their ENABLE_TRACER=OFF expansion), comments and whitespace (sha256 of the two masked sides); 'hookStatements': IF_TRACE statements that are neither a tracer variable nor a register call. A new difference fails the check until it is reviewed and listed here.

residue.reason: rewrite with identical behaviour: 'if (levels > 0) f();' becomes 'if (levels == 0) return; f();' at the end of a void function (so the hook can follow)
rewrite with identical behaviour: 'return f();' becomes 'auto result = f(); return result;' (so the result can be registered)
